subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: After the two concrete blockers are fixed, should the three linked bug fixes be split from the broader inference-first onboarding and runtime-contract migration, or should this combined upgrade be accepted as one change?
rationale: The branch mixes urgent fixes with plugin API, provider-auth, persistent-state, dependency, onboarding-ownership, and security-boundary changes; choosing the acceptable product and upgrade blast radius requires owner intent.

options.title: Split the linked fixes
options.body: Extract restart draining, deterministic handoff, and profile-isolated approval migration into narrow independently reviewed changes, then revisit the broader onboarding/runtime rewrite.

options.title: Accept the combined migration
options.body: Keep the branch intact only with explicit approval and proof for fresh installs, upgrades, provider auth, plugin contracts, dependencies, and recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Split the linked fixes
recommendation.body: Extract restart draining, deterministic handoff, and profile-isolated approval migration into narrow independently reviewed changes, then revisit the broader onboarding/runtime rewrite.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows direct ownership across nearly every central changed surface and the broad integration direction.
